_note: Raid planner: structures and their maximum HP. Hand-collected, not extracted.
maxHp = HP of the fully built, healthy structure. null = not measured yet.
Building blocks (walls, foundations, floors...) are entities, not Rust items, so
their keys are synthetic, of the form <block>.<grade> (wall.stone, foundation.wood,
floor.metal, ...). Deployables (doors, high externals, barricades...) use their real
category: free-form tag for the future hierarchical menu (block:twig / block:wood /
block:stone / block:metal / block:armored / door / gate / external / deployable).
The menu tree itself will be decided later from these tags.
